name: Haruno Ichigo
source: A talented girl who jumps to the 7th grade from 3rd grade. She is very smart and uses her talent as a detective. She really likes sweets. She uses the power of sweets to fight with the world.
translation: A talented girl who jumps to the 7th grade from 3rd grade. She is very smart and uses her talent as a detective. She really likes sweets. She uses the power of sweets to fight with the world.
